clue.text: Drama about caretaker, for example, initially powerless in mutual action

indicators.note: the opening letter P, the usual abbreviation for power, is lost from the front of the phrase

parts.note: The Caretaker is a play by Harold Pinter, so it is an example of a Pinter play

explanation.surface: A play about a caretaker shows people sapped of strength while acting on each other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially powerless' drops the leading P (power) from PINTER PLAY. The Caretaker (1960) is one of Harold Pinter's best-known plays.
explanation.definitionFit: Interplay is the way two or more things act upon and affect one another, a reciprocal effect.

clue.text: African animals in US city, unfortunately

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York
alas is an exclamation of regret, said when things go badly

explanation.surface: Wild animals from Africa are sadly found in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: Nyalas are southern African antelopes with spiral horns.

clue.text: Still being taken out of context, antagonistically

explanation.walkthrough: 'Still being taken' reads as one phrase, but 'Still being' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something extant is still in existence, surviving to the present.

clue.text: Vote on a couple of points that may need to be counted

definitions.text: that may need to be counted

parts.note: a poll is a vote

explanation.surface: Voting on a pair of issues where the ballots must be tallied.
explanation.walkthrough: A pollen count is the measure of pollen in the air given in hay-fever forecasts.
explanation.definitionFit: Grains from flowers are measured daily as a count in the summer for hay-fever sufferers.

clue.text: Scratch American ring? Something like that

parts.note: to scratch a plan is to cancel or annul it

explanation.surface: Cancelling an American wrestling ring, or something like that.
explanation.definitionFit: An annulus is a ring-shaped figure, the area between two concentric circles.

clue.text: Reckless Democrat on a McCarthyite obsession

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for Democrat in US politics
Senator McCarthy in 1950s America was obsessed with the supposed menace of communism, the red evil

explanation.surface: A rash Democrat is fixated on communist-hunting.
explanation.walkthrough: Joseph McCarthy led the 1950s US hunt for communists, or Reds.
explanation.definitionFit: A daredevil, used as an adjective, describes someone bold to the point of recklessness.

clue.text: Leaving instructions about change of mind for green energy sources

indicators.note: change of says the letters of mind are reordered

explanation.surface: Rewriting a will to back renewable power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaving instructions' reads as directions for departing, but means the documents left at death; 'change of mind' hides its anagram signal inside a familiar phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Windmills, including modern wind turbines, generate renewable power from the wind.

clue.text: Gentle quality of light concealed by black cape

indicators.note: concealed by says the verb sits hidden inside the other pieces

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
ness is a word for a headland or cape, as in Loch Ness place names
to light on something is to land on it

explanation.surface: A beam of light is hidden by a dark cloak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light' looks like brightness but is the verb meaning to alight or land; 'cape' is a headland, not a cloak.
explanation.definitionFit: Blandness is mildness, a lack of anything harsh or strong.

clue.text: Prophet avoiding pride through divine intervention

definitions.text: Prophet avoiding pride through divine intervention

parts.words: Prophet avoiding pride through divine intervention
parts.note: the Old Testament prophet thrown into the lions' den survived when God shut the lions' mouths; a group of lions is a pride

explanation.surface: A holy man is saved by God from the sin of arrogance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pride' looks like the deadly sin but means a group of lions, the beasts of the biblical den story.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical prophet was cast to the lions and kept safe by an angel, escaping the pride unharmed.

clue.text: Platform section next to end of railway track

parts.note: a section is a part

parts.note: a railway track is a line

explanation.surface: Directions to a station platform beside the last bit of rail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Platform' looks like a railway feature but means a political programme.
explanation.definitionFit: A political platform is the official policy a party sets out, which members are expected to follow.

clue.text: Bizarre denial included in introduction

indicators.note: something bizarre is strange and twisted, so the letters of denial are rearranged

explanation.surface: An introduction that includes an odd refusal.
explanation.definitionFit: A lead-in is introductory material that opens a broadcast or piece of writing before the main part.

clue.text: Isn't commonly included in unusual reply that's artistic, in a way

indicators.note: included in puts the colloquial word inside the rearranged letters
unusual signals the letters of reply in an odd order

parts.note: ain't is the colloquial, nonstandard form of isn't

explanation.surface: A slangy contraction turns up in an odd reply, giving it a certain artistic flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Isn't commonly' points to the everyday slang contraction; 'artistic, in a way' warns that the word means painting-like rather than simply artistic.
explanation.definitionFit: Painterly describes art or writing with the qualities of painting, so it is artistic in one particular way.

clue.text: Caught returning from island in Med

indicators.note: returning says the synonym is read from right to left

parts.note: to be nailed is to be caught out

explanation.surface: Someone is arrested coming back from a Mediterranean holiday island.
explanation.walkthrough: Delos is a Greek island in the Aegean; Delian means belonging to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Delian is the adjective for Delos, the small Greek island where Apollo was said to be born.

clue.text: Provide drinks in part of plant — it's said to increase turnover

parts.note: a stalk is the stem of a plant
ales are drinks

explanation.surface: Serve drinks among the greenery to boost the takings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Provide' is a link word joining the drinks to their position.
explanation.definitionFit: A salesman's patter is meant to persuade buyers and so boost the volume of trade.

clue.text: Courage of new piece of text inserted in service

indicators.note: inserted in says the abbreviation and the piece of text go inside the service

parts.note: Mass is a church service
a line is a piece of text

explanation.surface: Bravery from a fresh passage added to the liturgy.
explanation.definitionFit: Manliness is traditionally associated with bravery and boldness.

clue.text: Succeeded in becoming editor: did well

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation inside the word for fitting

parts.note: becoming means fitting or proper
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in family trees

explanation.surface: A journalist achieved success by rising to editor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Succeeded' wants to be the definition, but it is only the S; 'did well' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: To have prospered is to have flourished or done well financially.

clue.text: Foolish person raises, ignoring the odds

indicators.note: dropping the odd-numbered letters leaves the second, fourth and sixth letters of raises

explanation.surface: A fool lifts things up, regardless of the betting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the odds' looks like gambling odds but means the odd-placed letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ass is an everyday insult for a stupid or silly person, from the donkey's reputation.

clue.text: Unit that, for example, is central

indicators.note: the central three letters of example are taken

explanation.surface: A measure which, for instance, sits in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for example' looks like a phrase but 'example' is the word whose centre gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The amp, or ampere, is the SI unit of electric current.

clue.text: Signs contract really finally in pen

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: Someone at last signs the deal with a pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' looks like a writing pen to sign with but is an enclosure for pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: A sty is a pen where pigs are kept.

clue.text: Opts for post, say, in an Indian city, beginning in March

parts.note: Agra is the Indian city of the Taj Mahal

indicators.note: beginning in takes the first letter of March

explanation.surface: Someone picks an Indian city's mail service at the start of March.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is an example: the letters of 'opts' rearranged make 'post'. 'Opts' and 'post' look like choosing and mail.
explanation.definitionFit: Each word is the other's letters rearranged, so one is an example of a word-shuffle.

clue.text: Lets rip with changes, complex peals of bells

indicators.note: with changes says the letters of the two words are reordered, apt since bell-ringers ring changes

explanation.surface: A bell-ringer lets fly with changes on an intricate peal.
explanation.walkthrough: In English change ringing, Triples is the name for methods rung on seven bells.
explanation.definitionFit: Triples are change-ringing methods on seven bells, where three pairs swap places at each change.

clue.text: Habitually sail over layer of rock

definitions.meaning: a ship that plies a route travels it regularly

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to travel a route regularly and a single layer of a material.

clue.text: Pervasively influences to abandon partnership

parts.note: to leave is to abandon
North and South are a partnership in bridge

explanation.surface: Someone's influence spreads, making them quit a business partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, the players North and South form one partnership.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaven is yeast that spreads through dough, so to leaven figuratively is to permeate and modify.

clue.text: After conversion lets in to join service

indicators.note: conversion is a change of form, so the letters of lets in are rearranged

explanation.surface: Once converted, a church lets newcomers join its worship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' looks like a church service but means the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: To enlist is to sign up for military service.

clue.text: Work of art from university in Washington or New York, say

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the state

parts.note: Washington and New York are both US states

explanation.surface: A sculpture from a college in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: Washington and New York look like cities but are taken as states.
explanation.definitionFit: A statue is a sculpted figure, a classic piece of art.

clue.text: Funny priest's wit

indicators.note: funny suggests something odd, so the letters of priest are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.definitionFit: Esprit is liveliness of mind and quick wit, borrowed from French.

clue.text: A wife inhabiting one part of Africa or another

parts.note: Mali is a country in West Africa

explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: a different African country from the one in the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Malawi is a further African country, in the south-east, distinct from Mali.

clue.text: Like a thinking man's raison d'être

definitions.text: Like a thinking man's raison d'être

parts.words: Like a thinking man's raison d'être
parts.note: Descartes said 'I think, therefore I am': thinking is the very reason a man exists

explanation.surface: A description of what keeps an intellectual going.
explanation.walkthrough: Descartes's 'cogito ergo sum' makes thinking the proof of being, so a thinking man's reason for existing is his philosophy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartesian means relating to Descartes, whose philosophy rests on thought proving existence.

clue.text: Use some tact in selecting what's for show

indicators.note: Use some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Advice to be diplomatic when choosing a display.
explanation.definitionFit: Tinsel is showy decoration, glitter with no real substance.

clue.text: Unorthodox stance about a religious teaching can be this

definitions.text: Unorthodox stance about a religious teaching can be this

parts.note: RI is religious instruction, a school subject in Britain

clue.text: Silent treatment that may be said to get someone's attention

definitions.text: that may be said to get someone's attention

clue.text: Discover a canister at sea
